iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

GTP::discard
       Discards the current message.

SYNOPSIS
       GTP::discard

DESCRIPTION
       Discards the current message

       Syntax

       GTP::discard

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when GTP_SIGNALLING_INGRESS {
	    GTP::discard
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0 --First introduced the command.
